summary: Camber Energy filed an 8-K regarding a $500,000 promissory note issued by its majority-owned subsidiary Viking Ozone Technology, LLC to an accredited investor. The note carries 10% fixed interest, matures by April 15, 2027 or upon sale of a VKIN-300 waste treatment unit, and is secured by a pari passu interest on net sale proceeds from that unit. It contains customary default provisions but no conversion rights or warrant. This is a routine debt financing agreement, not a special situation.
